paper_title: Data-driven discovery of turbulent flow equations using physics-informed neural networks
evidence_summary: The paper's Data Availability statement says that the data supporting the findings are openly available on Kaggle at DOI 10.34740/kaggle/dsv/2637500 and reference [72] cites the same McConkey-Yee-Lien dataset. The DOI resolves to the exact version-3 Kaggle record.
evidence_location: Data Availability and reference [72]; Kaggle Data Card

paper_title: Simulation of 3D turbulent flows using a discretized generative model physics-informed neural networks
evidence_summary: The Stage-1 resource URL is the DOI of Atlas paper 692 itself, not a dataset. The primary article explicitly states that training/testing data originate from the Johns Hopkins Turbulence Database (already represented by CR000307/PRL000224) and separately identifies its DG-PINN GitHub repository for data and code. The self-DOI therefore does not verify the Stage-1 paper_dataset_mention assertion.
evidence_location: article DOI/front matter; problem setup/data-source statement; public data/code statement

paper_title: Automatic Detection of Diabetic Retinopathy from Fundus Images using Machine Learning Based Approaches
evidence_summary: The primary paper states that the EyePACS dataset was taken from the DR competition dataset on Kaggle and describes the same five-class fundus-image data; its reference [19] gives the exact https://www.kaggle.com/c/diabetic-retinopathy-detection URL. This directly verifies the Stage-1 dataset relationship.
evidence_location: Research Methodology, Data Set Collection and Data Split Process; reference [19]; Kaggle Data page
